pages.text: A $(item)Descriptive Book$() creates and links to an Age the first time you use it. A $(item)Linking Book$() records the place where it was written. Bring one with you if you want a reliable way home.
If you die in an Age without a personal spawn set, you respawn back into that Age. Unsafe Ages can still strand you, so a prepared traveler carries at least one spare link.
